blogs.title: How to Mine 120 Billion Math Problems from the Web (And Why It Works)
blogs.description: An accessible deep dive into how DeepSeekMath constructed its massive training corpus from Common Crawl. This post explains the fastText classification pipeline, the iterative data collection process, and why focusing on scraped web pages actually beats relying solely on academic papers or aggregators like MathPile for teaching models mathematics.

blogs.title: Why 'Code Training' Might Be the Secret Ingredient Your Model Needs
blogs.description: Exploring the paper's surprising discovery that training a model on code patterns before math problems significantly boosts reasoning abilities. We break down the experiments showing how a 7B model started with code tokens improved its ability to solve complex math problems without tools, effectively answering a long-standing debate in the AI community.

blogs.title: Simplifying Reinforcement Learning: The Case for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
blogs.description: A friendly explanation of GRPO, a new RL algorithm that promises to be more memory-efficient than PPO. Instead of an expensive 'critic' model, GRPO uses group comparisons to optimize math answers. We look at how this simplifies training without sacrificing performance on benchmarks like MATH and GSM8K.
